propositions: Command identity resolution and execution must traverse a single validated registry route instead of parallel explicit intercept/dispatch ladders and policy frozensets.
The selected lazy handler must be invoked through a closed typed adapter set without re-parsing command/nested options, preserving original remainder argv unchanged.
Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policy (none/init_only/full), and conditional selectors must match pre-cutover behavior for all routes including no-auto-mount cases.

Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must maintain backward compatibility with existing behavioral contracts.
Bridge compatibility spellings must execute through approved adapters while unknown commands like purge-bridge remain unresolved.
Rollback capability must be preserved via derived compatibility exports without changes to handler signatures, generated help, or persisted data.
